notes.title: Meta Sudoku: Ultimate Update (Part 1/2)
notes.notes:
[h1][b]After months of waiting, the new version is finally here![/b][/h1]


[h2][b]1.240 New Classic Mode Levels and Endless Mode Content[/b][/h2]

[b]Over the past three months, I dedicated the majority of my time to crafting these puzzles. Each level is meticulously designed to ensure a single, unique solution.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42637503/e3831f8c45051400bba0ac0a87374e7d68fd8aeb.jpg[/img]
[list]
[b][*] Structure: All puzzles are presented with rotational symmetry.

[*] Difficulty: The levels gradually increase in difficulty, with each tier becoming significantly more challenging than the last. Overall, these puzzles are harder compared to previous versions.

[*] (Note: This update might invalidate previous Classic Mode records. However, this change ensures a better gameplay experience, as past puzzles might have had multiple solutions.)
[/list][/b]

[h2][b]2.More Compact Grid Layout[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42637503/98d46d452f71303f0e14545bc647a8b055f99e79.jpg[/img]

The split layout has been removed, and the Sudoku grid is now more compact.

This layout enhances efficiency during gameplay.

(If necessary, a customizable layout feature may be added in the next update.)

[h2][b]3.Night Mode Removed[/b][/h2]

[b]The old Night Mode color scheme was suboptimal, so this feature has been removed. In the next update, you’ll have the option to fully customize the color palette.[/b]

[h2][b]4.New Sound Effects and Completion Animations[/b][/h2]

[h2][b]5.Number Inspector Moved to the Bottom[/b][/h2]

This change not only improves aesthetics but also leaves room for new features coming in the next update.

[h2][b]6.Massive Theme Update: 6 New Geometry Themes + 6 Gradient Themes[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42637503/c93371d4dd32b98f7f91babf614662cbb3fffdfa.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42637503/e42f82d349be09f1467486363308898b31fb1fe5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42637503/8477569c6b193638b0ca4d628918352ffb92c97b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42637503/c9a5b0ba484a68d6d123e6ec3aac2da2851f886d.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Features Coming in the Next Update:[/b][/h1]
[olist]
[*] [h3]A brand-new UI system

[*] Multi-select: Make notes for multiple cells simultaneously

[*] Full-grid marking options

[*] Post-level review: View the solution and completion time.......[/h3]

[/olist]

...and much more!

[h1][b]Of course, these features will take time to develop.

In the meantime, enjoy the game![/b][/h1]

notes.title: Major update: Meta Sudoku
notes.notes:
[h1][b]After upgrading in recent days, the latest version of MetaSudoku has arrived![/b][/h1]

[h1][b]The new version is updated as follows:[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]Lobby interface:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] [i]1. Fix a major bug: When you enter the game for the second time and stay on the lobby page, the game becomes invalid. The temporary solution is to close the Steam cloud archive. Now, there is no need for this operation, and the bug has been perfectly fixed! You can continue to use Steam Cloud Archive.
[*] 2. The lobby interface tab can be directly clicked to improve interface efficiency.
[*] 3. Partial font synchronization updates.[/i]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42637503/c86fae0b892ad6cdeedcc1a94cfb60cc7c32033f.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Sudoku level option interface:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] [i]1. The redrawn setup logo prevents some players from ignoring this significant feature.
[*] 2. Level progress reversal color, progress 0% ->white, progress 100% ->black.
[*] 3. Level progress focuses more on the percentage of completion you have achieved.
[*] 4. Adjust the color, animation, and font size for each mode section, and display the progress of that section.
[*] 6. Add shadows and animations to each level option to enhance stereoscopic and interactive effects.
[*] 7. Added 25 new Pack mode levels.[/i]

notes.title: Meta Sudoku Shocking Release !
notes.notes:
After several months of development, Meta Sudoku finally landed on Steam!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42637503/467e1177b0b7224cbb1cd33dc69bd379877b178d.jpg[/img]

[h3][b] Function Introduction: [/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] 1. You can choose from four different modes, of course, some modes require you to trigger specific conditions to unlock.
[*] 2. You can turn off certain settings because you don't need them at all. Then, please play Sudoku on a clean interface.
[*] 3. Over a dozen clean music tracks and enjoy stereo functionality.
[*] 4. The levels are challenging and there are some achievements that you need to achieve.
[/list]

......

More content awaits you to explore!

[h1][b]Buy now and enjoy a 40% discount on the first release![/b] [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42637503/897923a9161cf08de4cc58e13eaa04a8ba4bff12.jpg[/img]

Stay tuned!
